goal: Speed up serving historical and legacy block requests and reduce node memory and CPU usage
Avoids slow block decoding and re-encoding when peers request blocks without witness data
agreement: Strong support with thorough verification and no objections
Verified by testing byte-for-byte output equivalence and measuring 7x to 9x speedups (fametrano)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it speeds up serving non-witness blocks by roughly 9x with much lower memory usage
Removes an asymmetric CPU load from legacy requests and helps enable faster witnessless initial sync
